verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a public API reference with concrete endpoints: listing and resuming agent runs, retrieving run logs and traces, querying org integrations, generating setup commands, analyzing sandbox logs, and editing PR state. It also ships a Python SDK described as a thin wrapper with the same capabilities, plus a CLI, so the product can be driven programmatically end-to-end. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
